title: Contextual trajectory and incremental contextual displacement: Towards using LLMs to understand dynamic, utterance-specific meaning construction
abstract: arXiv:2610.00840v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) such as RoBERTa represent text using contextual word embeddings (CWEs), which alter the embeddings associated with each token based on surrounding context. We construct token-wise incremental trajectories by repeatedly recomputing a token's CWE as successive words are added to a sentence, yielding a representation of how contextualized embeddings evolve as the utterance unfolds. We evaluate this approach using garden-path sentences as a test case with characteristic features. Token-wise trajectories reproduce known features of garden-path processing, including disruption around the critical region, and reliably distinguish garden-path sentences from matched disambiguated controls. We introduce several metrics for quantifying representational displacement across contextual increments and show that trajectory information can be highly predictive of sentence type. translated_title: 语境轨迹与增量语境位移：利用大语言模型理解动态的、特定于话语的意义建构
translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的大语言模型（如RoBERTa）使用情境词嵌入（CWE）来表示文本，CWE会根据周围语境改变与每个词元相关的嵌入表示。我们通过在句子中逐步添加后续词语并反复重新计算某一词元的CWE，构建了逐词元的增量轨迹，从而刻画了情境化嵌入如何随话语的展开而演变。我们以花园路径句作为具有典型特征的测试用例来评估这一方法。逐词元轨迹再现了花园路径句加工的已知特征，包括关键区域附近的加工受阻，并能可靠地将花园路径句与匹配的消歧对照组区分开来。我们引入了若干用于量化语境增量间表征位移的指标，并表明轨迹信息对句子类型具有很强的预测能力。我们发现与歧义相关的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出通过逐词增量构建大语言模型中词元的情境词嵌入轨迹并量化其表征位移，成功再现并预测了花园路径句的加工特征，为利用LLM理解动态的、特定于话语的意义建构提供了新方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes constructing token-wise incremental contextual embedding trajectories in LLMs and quantifying representational displacement across contextual increments, which successfully reproduces and predicts garden-path sentence processing, offering a new approach to understanding dynamic, utterance-specific meaning construction with LLMs.
